As a result, gross profit grew at a stable rate, keeping in line with management’s expectations. The company’s operating income saw an uptick, indicating that the firm was able to manage its administrative and selling expenses effectively, while also benefiting from a more streamlined supply chain. Net income also rose, bolstered by favorable tax conditions and reduced interest expenses due to a restructuring of long-term debt.
